items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] How are you feeling, Paz? Oh, fine. How you been? Good.

ctx.x: No, that's all right, Paz. Just as if we were visiting. You don't have to worry.
How are you feeling, Paz? Oh, fine. How you been? Good.
How long since you saw one another? Not so long. How long has it been?
